newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-BARTHEZ SUPPORTS LAMA IN CANNABIS CASE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARTHEZ SUPPORTS LAMA IN CANNABIS CASE.

text.p: Fabien Barthez, likely to replace Bernard Lama as France's goalkeeper if the Paris St Germain international is suspended for smoking cannabis, said on Saturday he fully supported his colleague.
Lama faces a possible two-month ban for failing a dope test for cannabis in February. Barthez was banned for two months in October 1995 after traces of cannabis were found in his urine.
French federation officials are waiting for a second sample from Barthes to be analysed before making a decision. That should take about two weeks.

"Bernard's ban ? It is just ridiculous. When people say that cannabis is used as a pain killer, it makes me laugh. I don't know whether it will allow me to become France's number one player and I don't want to know," Barthes said.
"But I also want to tell Bernard such an experience can be useful. It helped me work harder and prove than it was not thanks to cannabis that I was a good goalkeeper,"
